description: A screaming yellow pouch, the loudest object in the room. CITRUS DAWN — WAKE UP AND TASTE THE SUNRISE! It has been designed by somebody who was told what an orange is but has never met one.
name: soylent pouch (citrus dawn)

tags.description: A screaming yellow pouch, the loudest object in the room. CITRUS DAWN — WAKE UP AND TASTE THE SUNRISE! It has been designed by somebody who was told what an orange is but has never met one.
tags.use_message: Sharp, cold, and violently yellow, and for a moment it is almost refreshing. Then the citrus lets go all at once and what is underneath is still the same grey slurry as everything else, now with a bright chemical aftertaste sitting on top of it like a lid.
